avis.texte: I gave this a try, because I liked the ingredients listed, other reviews, and price. I am usually a little skeptical when purchasing face products online. I have honestly not done it very often. I have been using this cream for about a month. It is amazing. A little goes a long way, so I found that I had to figure out, by trial and error, the right amount for my skin (which is on the dry side in this winter weather). It is lightweight and soaks into the skin beautifully. I love that it's not thick. It feels almost like a spa treatment when putting it on. The fragrance is light, but very pleasant. I have very sensitive skin and have had no negative side effects from it. I haven't noticed that it clogs my pores, which is always a concern with new products. I must say, I have spent thousands of dollars on high end cosmetics through the years (I'm 74 years old) and this outranks so many that I've tried. My skin has improved with this cream. It's softer and I believe looks more radiant. I didn't take before and after photos, but I would say that my wrinkles have also softened. Those results are difficult to accomplish with seniors' skin. I would definitely recommend giving this moisturizer a try.

Not bad but not amazing either. Sensitive skin safe, no irritation or break outs. I used this for 4 months in combo with the toner and didn’t notice any brightening effects or improvement in evening out skin tone. I live in a very dry climate and I didn’t find this to be moisturizing enough for my skin. It worked well for me with a face oil after applying. If you like gel creams, I think this is a good affordable alternative for the belief Aquabomb. Not sticky or greasy.

avis.titre: I truly love it!  My skin glows!
avis.texte: Repurchased 5 times already. Yes! I absolutely love this moisturizer. I use it after my retinol layer. I started using it when I was going through a serious retinol skin purge. I didn’t want to give up on retinol like I had in the past. So I did research and saw a Korean skincare influencer highly recommend this product. As soon as I started using this Annua Peach Niacinamide Cream my skin immediately stopped getting dry and pealing from the retinol. This cream feels so soothing, cool and refreshing on my skin. I literally can’t wait for this step at the end of my skincare routine. I use way more than I need to on purpose because it just feels so great and I view it as a treat! So I go through it a lot! But I don’t care. I just can’t really describe what a great feeling it is to put this on my face! I have multiple skin care steps but I had added this most recently. The very next day after starting to use it I saw an amazing and definite change for the better! Now my skin actually glows and I hardly wear makeup anymore (just sunscreen) because I don’t have any redness or blotchiness to cover. When I do wear makeup my skin looks absolutely amazing! Even better than when I was younger. Maybe I should buy stocks in this stuff. It’s that great! Not exaggerating, at all! I wish I had started using this years ago!
I am obsessed with this stuff, works great. Skin looks so bouncy and moisturized and glowly. Works excellent under makeup to

This is my second time purchasing this moisturizer, and I still love it! It absorbs into my skin so quickly without leaving behind any greasy or heavy feeling, which is a huge plus for me. It keeps my face feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized all day, and it layers really well under sunscreen and makeup. A little goes a long way, and my skin always feels hydrated without looking shiny. I’ll definitely continue repurchasing!
This is amazing cream! Moisturizing, non greasy and so soft and smooth afterwards! I also bought the face wash for a second time. Great value because it's highly concentrated! Buy it!
This cream is amazing! It’s lightweight, very moisturizing, and leaves my skin soft and glowing. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel sticky. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I have a Amazon TV which is great, however the commercials are all Amazon products, that's how I ended up buying this along with a line filler in a tube & a water type spray, my skin was dry & I wanted to try something new, it was ok, i probably won't reorder.
I’ve purchased twice now. I have dry skin, and the serum and moisturizer together are very hydrating yet lightweight. I love these products. I did like the previous packaging better though.
c'est une recommande pour moi. Produit efficace pour peau mature. Ca dure longtemps ca il en faut peu. Combine au serum et au tonique, c'est un must.
Muy buena, me ayuda mucho con el acné. La textura me encanta y huele muy bien.

It sinks into your skin quickly and my skin feels soft and hydrated. I have only been using this along with the serum for a couple of days so I cannot speak to its long term effect but it seems good so far

avis.titre: Not a Miracle Cream — Just Gorgeous Skin, Hydration, and Glow
avis.texte: I love Anua products, and this cream is another reason why the brand continues to impress me. They have a talent for making skincare that feels modern, enjoyable to use, and focused on giving the skin a healthy, radiant look rather than making unrealistic promises. At 52, post-menopausal, with dry skin that can also become sensitive, I’m very aware that no moisturizer is going to “turn back time” overnight. I don’t expect miracles from creams anymore. What I do want is hydration, barrier support, smoother texture, and that fresh glow that makes skin look healthier. This delivers exactly that. The first thing I noticed was the texture. It feels rich enough to satisfy dry skin, but it is not heavy, greasy, or suffocating. It has that signature Korean skincare balance where it feels nourishing while still sitting comfortably on the skin. It spreads easily, absorbs well, and leaves the skin feeling soft and cushioned and it is fragrance free. What really sets this apart for me is the glow. Not oily shine. Not sticky shine. A healthy, plump, hydrated radiance that makes skin look well cared for. On days when my skin looks dull or tired, this gives me the kind of finish that makes me look more rested and refreshed. It is important to be realistic: this is not a miracle anti-aging cream that erases wrinkles overnight. It is something better—a cream that consistently helps skin look better day to day. This feels good on my face in the morning. Give it a try if you have dry skin. Great quality, don't look at price. Lasted me longer than a month so far. About 2 or 3 months so far.

It smells softly like peach (nothing overpowering), blends like butter, and gives a velvety finish. The niacinamide + peach extract brightens the skin while keeping it hydrated through the day. Great for dull, dry, or uneven skin.

A lovely cream moisturizer for your face. Even with the thicker texture than the moisturizer milk, it still absorbs completely into your skin locking peach kernel and Niacin benefits into your skin for deep repair. avis.titre: Nice product but not right for me
avis.texte: Product is light weight, moisturizing and best of all has a great price point. I was excited to try after reading the reviews. However, it wasn’t right for me. Little red bumps appeared all over my face and neck after using this product. This may work for you but something in it didn’t agree with my skin. I ultimately returned the product.
I ordered this on black Friday and just used it today and noticed that the container is only half full.

avis.titre: Light and Moisturizing, Light Peach Scent
avis.texte: I'm reviewing Anua Peach Niacinamide Cream, Face Moisturizer for Dry Skin with Vitamin B12, Collagen, Ceramide, Panthenol, Korean Skin Care, 50ml - 1.69 fl.oz. This cream feels good on my face. It's light, absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling moisturized. I used it on my face and neck, then rubbed the remaining lotion onto my hands. It has a pleasant peach scent and the lotion has a light peach color. Fragrance is listed as an ingredient, but no dyes are listed, so perhaps the color comes from the peach extract. See photo for package information including an ingredient list. It comes in a frosted hard acrylic jar and includes a scoop that lets me get out the amount I want without concern about contaminating the contents with my fingers. The scoop is easy to clean with soap and water after use. The EXP is 2027/06/11. At the current price of $19.00, I find it to be reasonable. As a side note, this Anua Peach Niacinamide Cream is made in Korea.

Since the ingredients are not in English I’m not sure what’s in this cream, but I used it anyway and I really like the way it makes my skin feel. It has a slight scent that is pleasant. It definitely left my skin feeling soft and moisturized. So I can say I’m happy with it but I wish I knew what was in it.

Definitely glossy skin right after the use, it shows perfectly just need a little time to soak up, I do feel it’s on a bit richer side so I had to give it few minutes even tho it’s kind of gel ish which is typically quick to absorb. Now my skin stayed fully hydrated thru the day, worked wonderfully with my serum, and just got that perfect skin tone without any dullness. Absolutely wonderful for my combination skin, no irritation or issues, just perfect!
